headline: Poland State Assets Ministry and Internal Security Agency Probe TVN Acquisition
summary: State Assets Minister Wojciech Balczun announced that a formal proceeding regarding the acquisition of TVN began, with the Internal Security Agency also reviewing the transaction.
why: Media ownership transactions in Poland are subject to rigorous regulatory and national security scrutiny by state authorities.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Governmental and security reviews impact corporate media acquisitions.
